text:
Predicates:
WorkLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
ComputerScienceDept(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
PartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakeCourse(x, y) ::: x takes the course y.
Instructed(x, y) ::: x is instructed by professor y.
WorkLab(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Premises:
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkLibrary(x) → ¬ComputerScienceDept(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ PartTimeJob(x) offeredByUniversity(x) → WorkLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ TakeCourse(x, database) → ComputerScienceDept(x)) ::: All students who take the database course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ Instructed(x, david) → TakeCourse(x, database)) ::: All students instructed by professor David are taking the database course.
∀x (Student(x) ∧ WorkLab(x) → Instructed(x, david)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by professor David.
Student(james) ∧ WorkLab(james) ::: James is a student working in the lab.
¬(PartTimeJob(jack) offeredByUniversity(jack) ∨ WorkLab(jack)) ::: Jack neither has a part-time job offered by the university nor works in the lab.
Conclusion:
¬PartTimeJob(james) offeredByUniversity(james) ::: James does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
